import argparse
import sys

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='pysemver')
s = parser.add_subparsers()

# create bump subcommand
parser_bump = s.add_parser('bump', help='Bumps a version')
parser_bump.set_defaults(which='bump')
sb = parser_bump.add_subparsers(title='Bump commands', dest='bump')

for cmd in ('major', 'minor', 'patch'):
    sb.add_parser(cmd, help=f'Bump {cmd}')

# Test with just 'bump'
args = parser.parse_args(['bump'])
print(f'args.which = {args.which}')
print(f'args.bump = {getattr(args, \"bump\", \"NOT SET\")}')
print(f'hasattr version: {hasattr(args, \"version\")}')
# Print help for bump subparser
parser_bump.print_help(file=sys.stdout)
sys.exit(0)
